name: Coder
description: Coder provides self-hosted cloud development environments. Admins describe workspaces as Terraform templates on VMs, containers or plain hosts, and developers create them from a web dashboard and connect through browser IDEs, VS Code or SSH.

notes.text: Docker is not available in the container, so the Docker starter templates do not work. Use templates that provision Proxmox VMs, cloud machines or existing SSH hosts.
Workspaces must reach CODER_ACCESS_URL; port forwarding to subdomains needs a real domain with a wildcard (CODER_WILDCARD_ACCESS_URL) in /etc/coder.d/coder.env.

app_vars.name: var_access_url
app_vars.label: Access URL
app_vars.help: URL users and workspaces reach Coder on, e.g. https://coder.example.com; defaults to http://<container IP>:3000
